npc.owner.name: Kenji Ogawa
line.owner.first.1: Ah, you're awake. Good. Your seat is waiting, as always.
line.hero.owner_first.2: As always? I've never been here before.
line.owner.first.3: Everyone says that. Time costs money, but don't worry, you still have some.
line.owner.first.5: Everyone has a way out. Not everyone sits it out to the end.
line.owner.again1.1: Don't touch the lights. They know when to burn.
line.hero.owner_again2.1: How much time do I have left?
line.owner.again2.2: Look at your screen. It's more honest with you than I am.
line.owner.again3.1: The cameras are rippling again today. Someone here is thinking too loudly.
line.owner.again4.1: The tea's run out. Come back later, maybe there'll be some.
npc.clerk.name: Hiroshi Yamada
line.clerk.first.1: Quiet, please. I'm filling cell D-forty-seven.
line.hero.clerk_first.2: Wait, you're painting in a spreadsheet?
line.clerk.first.3: It's a mountain. Thirty-one sheets. Every cell the right colour.
line.clerk.first.5: A camera costs money. Excel was already on my work computer.
line.clerk.again1.1: Don't lean over like that. You're casting a shadow on my monitor.
line.clerk.again2.2: Cherry blossoms. They need six hundred pink cells. Forty so far.
line.clerk.again3.1: Close the file without saving and the mountain is gone. I checked once.
line.clerk.again4.1: Your seat is next to mine. You keep typing the same thing over and over, you know?
npc.streamer.name: Nika
line.streamer.first.1: Oh, hi, you're on camera! Chat, say hello.
line.streamer.first.3: Three people. No, two now. One says you've got a weird face, don't mind him.
line.streamer.first.4: Step a little to the left, the light's warmer there.
line.streamer.again1.1: Chat is asking if you're alive or an NPC. I said I'm not sure myself.
line.streamer.again2.2: Not telling, it's a surprise for the viewers. There are zero right now, so the surprise worked.
line.streamer.again3.1: Don't stand behind me, my camera catches every move.
line.streamer.again4.1: A donation! Forty roubles and the message "let us out". They're funny.
npc.kid_boy.name: Tyoma
line.kid_boy.first.1: Don't block the screen, I'm on the boss.
line.kid_boy.first.3: Kinda. Since the morning. Or since yesterday. No windows here, you can't tell.
line.kid_boy.first.4: If you want a turn after me, you can call it. I won't be done soon though.
line.kid_boy.again1.1: I've played this level like forty times. It's a bit different every time, no joke.
line.kid_boy.again3.1: Hear the door creak at the end? Means someone left. Or came in.
line.kid_boy.again4.1: Sonya's lying about her high score. She's not even playing the same game.
npc.kid_girl.name: Sonya
line.kid_girl.first.1: Hi. Are you waiting for someone to pick you up too?
line.kid_girl.first.3: Well, somebody. Mum said, sit here for an hour. That was a long time ago.
line.kid_girl.first.4: At least there's internet here. Only one page, though.
line.kid_girl.again1.1: I counted the bulbs on the garland. I get a different number every time.
line.kid_girl.again2.2: A cat. It doesn't move, but sometimes it blinks. When nobody's looking.
line.kid_girl.again3.1: Tyoma thinks he's cool. But he keeps losing to the same boss.
line.kid_girl.again4.1: Are there letters on your screen too? Mine only has blue ones.
npc.guy_a.name: Stas
line.guy_a.first.1: Bro, not now, I'm in a ranked match.
line.hero.guy_a_first.2: I just wanted to ask something.
line.guy_a.first.3: Ask fast. The ping here is hell, but I'm used to it.
line.guy_a.first.4: Tip: the owner will give you an energy drink on credit. Only he remembers every debt.
line.guy_a.again1.1: Kicked again. Third time this match. The server must be in the next room.
line.guy_a.again2.2: Nobody. Nobody ever wins here, time just goes by.
line.guy_a.again3.1: If you see my screen go dark, wake me up. I'm not asleep, I'm in the lobby.
line.guy_a.again4.1: That Japanese guy with the spreadsheet is a legend. I saw his mountain. It's prettier than in any game.
npc.guy_b.name: Timur
line.guy_b.first.1: Oh, a new guy. Sit wherever you like, nobody leaves anyway.
line.hero.guy_b_first.2: What do you mean, nobody leaves?
line.guy_b.first.3: Well, they leave, but then they come back. This is my third time here. Or my first.
line.guy_b.first.4: Relax. It's warm, there's internet, what else do you need?
line.guy_b.again1.1: Watching a video about people building houses out of bottles. Six hours now.
line.hero.guy_b_again2.1: How did you end up here?
line.guy_b.again2.2: I was walking home from work and wanted to charge my phone. It never did charge, by the way.
line.guy_b.again3.1: The ventilation hums in A minor. I checked with a tuner.
line.guy_b.again4.1: Take it easy, bro. The conveyor doesn't go anywhere anyway.
npc.girl_a.name: Vera
line.girl_a.first.1: Shh. I'm typing in a program from a magazine, I can't lose my place.
line.girl_a.first.3: No idea. The magazine has no cover. Four hundred lines so far.
line.girl_a.first.4: If it turns out to be a game, I'll call you. If it isn't, I'll call you anyway.
line.girl_a.again1.1: Line two hundred and ten: PRINT "LYUDMILOVSK". Strange, isn't it?
line.girl_a.again2.2: It says "Error in line zero". There isn't even a line zero.
line.girl_a.again3.1: Everything here is older than me, except you. You're somehow too new.
line.girl_a.again4.1: Don't touch the cable. My whole evening is on that tape recorder.
npc.girl_b.name: Olya
npc.crowd_11.name: Gosha
npc.crowd_12.name: Liza
npc.crowd_13.name: Kirill
line.girl_b.first.1: Hi. You're not from the Lyudmilovsk chat by any chance?
line.girl_b.first.3: There's a forum where people say they've all dreamed of this club. I thought it was a joke.
line.girl_b.again1.1: New post: "if the owner gets up from his desk, talk to him right away". No idea why.
line.girl_b.again2.2: That there's one more seat past the last one. But nobody's made it there.
line.girl_b.again3.1: The moderator deleted everything about the door at the end again. Suspicious.
line.girl_b.again4.1: I save every page. In case they're gone later.

item.bird_feed.desc: A paper bag of sunflower seeds and millet. One handful is enough for one bird. Hold it, crouch and offer your palm (F).
item.feed_suet.name: Tit Cake
item.feed_suet.desc: Unsalted suet set with oats and sunflower seeds in a paper mould. Tits would sell their souls for it; robins and starlings won't say no either. Put it in a feeder or hold it out on your palm.
item.feed_niger.name: Goldfinch Mix
item.feed_niger.desc: Tiny black niger, thistle and burdock seeds. Sparrows don't care for them, but goldfinches come from far away. Chaffinches and bullfinches try them too.
item.feed_rowan.name: Dried Rowan
item.feed_rowan.desc: Dried rowan berries with sea buckthorn. Waxwings, bullfinches and fieldfares are mad about them, especially in the cold. Blackbirds come too.
item.feed_mealworm.name: Dried Mealworms
item.feed_mealworm.desc: Dried beetle larvae in a paper box. Food for the birds that won't eat grain: robins, thrushes, white wagtails, starlings.
item.feed_grain.name: Grain Mix "Dove"
item.feed_grain.desc: Wheat, barley and split peas. Pigeons, wood pigeons, rooks and jackdaws are sure to come, and the sparrows won't be far behind.
item.feed_peanuts.name: Peanuts for Birds
item.feed_peanuts.desc: Unsalted shelled peanuts in a mesh bag. Great tits and blue tits hang upside down on it; jackdaws and magpies like them as well.
item.feeder.name: Bird Feeder
item.feeder.desc: A wooden feeder house on a post. Set it up where birds live and put feed in it: in a couple of hours the birds that like that feed will come. While they eat it is easier to get close to them.
item.bread_loaf.name: Sliced Loaf
item.bread_loaf.desc: A fresh white loaf with slanting cuts on top. Bread is for people: it does birds no good.
item.kefir.name: Kefir

line.owner.sun_day.1: The sun is high up there now. I can feel it on the back of my neck, even from in here.
line.owner.sun_low.1: Sunset soon. Around this time my chest always gets warm. I don't know why.
line.owner.sun_night.1: The sun is on the other side of the earth now. That's all right. It always comes back.
line.owner.sun_cloudy.1: Clouds have covered it today. Can you feel it? Everything seems thinner.
line.clerk.sun_day.1: I painted the sun once. Nine hundred yellow cells. Afterwards the sheet felt warm.
line.clerk.sun_cloudy.1: It's overcast today. The yellow fill doesn't go on as well. Don't ask.
line.streamer.sun_low.1: Chat says the sun is setting. I feel it every time, honestly. Right on my skin.
line.kid_girl.sun_day.1: Can the sun see us? Even from here?
line.kid_girl.sun_night.1: Mum says the sun sleeps at night. I think it's just looking at other people.
line.guy_b.sun_day.1: Oh, it's so warm. Like the sun is warming my skin. Though there aren't even any windows here.
line.guy_b.sun_cloudy.1: Too bad the sun's gone behind the clouds. I can actually feel it, don't laugh.
line.girl_b.sun_day.1: On the forum they write: as long as the sun shines, we are remembered. Strange thing to say, right?

quest.awakening.title: Awakening
quest.awakening.desc: I came to in a computer club and remember nothing. I need to find out where I am.
quest.awakening.wake.log: I opened my eyes in front of a monitor. My heart is pounding. My profile on the computer is deleted, and I don't remember who I am.
quest.awakening.owner.log: The ATON club. Someone must know how I got here. The owner sits in his booth by the entrance.
quest.awakening.outside.log: The owner told me nothing much. Maybe things will be clearer outside.
quest.awakening.cable.log: Outside there is the sea, pines and an alley to a cable car. Down in the valley a little town shows.
quest.awakening.reach_cable.obj: Walk the alley to the cable car
quest.awakening.done: From here all of Lyudmilovsk is in view. I don't know who I am, but it seems one could live here.

quest.birds.desc: Pigeons feed by the club's door. They aren't afraid if you come quietly.
quest.birds.feed.log: There is a bag of feed in my pocket. If I crouch and hold out my palm, a bird might come.
quest.birds.done: A bird ate from my hand. It felt as if it knew me.

quest.soda.desc: There is a soda machine in the club. I am terribly thirsty.
quest.soda.drink.log: My mouth is dry. The machine by the wall has Baikal and Buratino.
quest.soda.drink_any.obj: Buy a soda from the machine and drink it
quest.soda.done: It tastes like childhood. Only I don't remember my childhood either.
quest.explore.title: Around here
quest.explore.desc: Since I'm here, I should see what's around.
quest.explore.walk.log: The beach under the cliff, the lower cable car station, the Academgorodok, the promenade. I should walk round them all.
quest.explore.see_beach.obj: Go down to the beach under the cliff
quest.explore.done: I've walked all round. The place is quiet and strangely familiar.

npc.nao.name: Nao
line.nao.first.1: You came out. I had a feeling someone would come out today.
line.nao.first.3: No. I just stand where the outside begins.
line.nao.first.4: I'm Nao. If you forget, that's fine, I'll remind you.
line.nao.again1.1: The sea is the same as yesterday. Or maybe I am.
line.nao.again2.2: It's a horse. It's always running and never gets anywhere.
line.nao.again3.1: Inside, everyone looks at screens. I'd rather stand out here, in the light.
line.nao.again4.1: If you stand by a door long enough, you start hearing it breathe.
line.nao.sun_day.1: It's warm. As if the sun were looking right at us today.
line.nao.sun_low.1: Wait, don't go. It's about to touch the water.
line.nao.sun_night.1: At night you can't see it, but I know where it is. Like it's behind a door.
line.nao.sun_cloudy.1: Clouds. It's fine, it's still up there. I can feel it.

item.postcard.desc: A promenade with a white balustrade. The back is empty: you could write on it.

npc.zotov_lev.name: Lev Zotov
line.zotov_lev.first.1: Not from the Laboratory? Pity. They need someone there who knows nothing.
line.zotov_lev.again1.1: Stare at an instrument long enough and it stares back. That's not physics, that's experience.
npc.zotova_galina.name: Galina Zotova
line.zotova_galina.first.1: Lev will be late again. He says "just a minute", and his minutes last an hour.
line.zotova_galina.again1.1: Fresh bread at the kiosk today. Tanya tells everyone, but keeps some only for her own.
npc.sato_kei.name: Kei Sato
line.sato_kei.first.1: The light by the sea is different. I measure it every day and still can't explain it.
line.sato_kei.again1.1: Yuki says the sun sets into the water. I don't argue. Neither do the instruments.
npc.sato_mila.name: Mila Sato
line.sato_mila.first.1: You look pale. Go to the sea and stand in the sun. Doctor's orders.
line.sato_mila.again1.1: On my day off we're taking the train to the island. It runs right over the water; Yuki squeals every time.
npc.sato_yuki.name: Yuki
line.sato_yuki.first.1: Did you know the train goes over the sea? I saw it myself. The wheels get wet.
line.sato_yuki.again1.1: Mum says the birds on the island aren't scared of anyone. Not even me.
npc.korneev_ivan.name: Ivan Korneev
line.korneev_ivan.first.1: I remember this house when the plaster still smelled fresh. Forty years fixing what breaks.
line.korneev_ivan.again1.1: Fished off the shore this morning. Caught nothing, but saw the sun come up. Good catch.
npc.korneeva_nina.name: Nina Korneeva
line.korneeva_nina.first.1: New here? I know everyone. I don't know you yet, but not for long.
line.korneeva_nina.again1.1: Vanya's off with his rod again. No fish, and he's happy. Men.
npc.belov_misha.name: Misha Belov
line.belov_misha.first.1: At the Laboratory I solder what the scientists dream up. Sometimes it works first time.
line.belov_misha.again1.1: From the lookout the whole town looks like a circuit diagram. Just no labels.
npc.orlova_tanya.name: Tanya Orlova
npc.orlova_tanya.role: sells at the Grocery No. 7 kiosk
line.orlova_tanya.first.1: Bread, milk, kefir. We've got matches. No sunshine, they don't deliver it.
line.orlova_tanya.again1.1: That's Nina's third time today. Not for bread, of course. To talk.
npc.lange_pyotr.name: Pyotr Lange
line.lange_pyotr.first.1: I put out to sea in the dark. I'm back about when you wake up.
line.lange_pyotr.again1.1: Mornings the train passes my boat. The driver always sounds the horn. I wave.
npc.kimura_dasha.name: Dasha Kimura
line.kimura_dasha.first.1: I'm studying physics. So far physics is studying me, and not gently.
line.kimura_dasha.again1.1: After lectures I'm off to the island. No wi-fi there, but there's a horizon.
npc.li_vika.name: Vika Li
npc.li_vika.role: lab assistant, shares a flat with Dasha
line.li_vika.first.1: I wash flasks for great discoveries. So far only the window has opened.
line.li_vika.again1.1: Dasha's gone to the island again. Said she'd be back on the last train. I knew it.
npc.valiev_rustam.name: Rustam Valiev
line.valiev_rustam.first.1: Engineer. Meaning I'll say "no" first and then build it.
line.valiev_rustam.again1.1: Everything here is built to last. Even the quiet on the stairs seems drawn to plan.
npc.nishimura_aya.name: Aya Nishimura
line.nishimura_aya.first.1: I paint the same island every day. It's different every day.
line.nishimura_aya.again1.1: The morning train is the best: the sun behind you, and the water like glass.
npc.sorokin_oleg.name: Oleg Sorokin
line.sorokin_oleg.first.1: Sorokin, from the Russian for magpie. Yes, I study birds. The name obliges.
line.sorokin_oleg.again1.1: On the island the starlings settle right before sunset. As if they set their watches by the sun.

line.hero.europa_planet.1: Is that... us? There's nothing there. Just the sea... and our island.

npc.khuazhev_aslan.role: sells Adyghe cheese at a tent by the club
line.khuazhev_aslan.first.1: My mother and sisters make the cheese, I bring it from Adygea. Try the braid: it's smoked, it tastes of the fire.
line.khuazhev_aslan.again1.1: Take the big round if you want it to last. The small one is for one evening.
npc.guseva_valentina.name: Valentina Guseva
npc.guseva_valentina.role: sells boiled corn in the Academgorodok
line.guseva_valentina.first.1: The corn's hot, just boiled. I don't spare the salt, I'll tell you that now.
line.guseva_valentina.again1.1: Cobs from the dacha, still milky. Take some while the season lasts.

item.cigarettes.desc: A pack of ten filter cigarettes. The pack says it honestly: smoking harms your health.

item.find_acorn.name: Acorn
item.find_acorn.desc: A sound oak acorn. Jays bury thousands every autumn and never find half of them; that is how oaks get planted.
item.find_hazelnut.name: Hazelnut
item.find_hazelnut.desc: A whole hazelnut. A nutcracker remembers where it hid each one, even under snow.
item.find_walnut.name: Walnut
item.find_walnut.desc: Crows drop them on the road from a height until the shell cracks. This one is still whole.
item.find_pinecone.name: Pine cone
item.find_pinecone.desc: A Scots pine cone. Nutcrackers pick the seeds out of them.
item.find_mussel.name: Mussel
item.find_mussel.desc: A blue mussel from the low tide. Hooded crows carry them to the road and smash them on the stones.
item.find_bottlecap.name: Bottle cap
item.find_bottlecap.desc: A red and gold crown cap. No jackdaw flies past one of these.
item.find_foil.name: Sweet wrapper
item.find_foil.desc: Crumpled gold foil from a sweet. It shines, so the magpies want it more than you do.
item.find_ring.name: Brass ring
item.find_ring.desc: A thin brass ring. Whose it was and how the birds got it, nobody knows.
item.find_button.name: Button
item.find_button.desc: A dark four-hole button off somebody's coat.
item.find_coin.name: Coin
item.find_coin.desc: A small brass coin, worn too smooth to read the year.
item.find_key.name: Old key
item.find_key.desc: A small key to some door. Somebody in town is probably still looking for it.
item.find_seaglass.name: Sea glass
item.find_seaglass.desc: A green shard the sea has rolled to a frosted smoothness.

festival.first_snow.today: The first snow has fallen: everyone gathers in the park today, with hot tea at the stalls.
festival.winter_fair.name: Winter Fair
festival.winter_fair.today: The winter fair is on in the square, from noon until eight.
festival.new_year.name: New Year
festival.new_year.today: New Year holidays: on New Year's Eve there's a tree in the square and fireworks over the sea at midnight.
festival.maslenitsa.name: Maslenitsa
festival.maslenitsa.today: It's Maslenitsa: pancakes at the fair, and at four the straw effigy burns on the beach.
festival.bird_day.name: Bird Day
festival.bird_day.today: It's Bird Day: this morning birdhouses go up in the park.
festival.blossom.name: Blossom Day
festival.blossom.today: It's Blossom Day: picnics in the park under the blossoming trees all day.
festival.midsummer.name: Midsummer Night
festival.midsummer.today: It's Midsummer Night: a bonfire on the beach until two, and then everyone waits for the sunrise.
festival.fisherman_day.name: Fisherman's Day
festival.fisherman_day.today: It's Fisherman's Day: a fish fair on the promenade, a concert in the square at four.
festival.perseids.name: Perseid Night
festival.perseids.today: Tonight the Perseids fall: from half past ten everyone is on the beach watching the shooting stars.
festival.harvest_fair.name: Harvest Fair
festival.harvest_fair.today: The Harvest Fair is on today, nine to five at the fair square.
festival.soon.fireworks: Fireworks over the sea soon: everyone is heading to the pier.
festival.soon.sky_lanterns: The sky lanterns go up from the beach soon.

quest.fest_sea_festival.title: The Sea Festival
quest.fest_sea_festival.desc: The town is celebrating: a fair, a concert, and fireworks over the pier tonight.
quest.fest_sea_festival.go.log: Go to the fair, and in the evening down to the sea for the fireworks.
quest.fest_sea_festival.fireworks.obj: Watch the fireworks over the sea
quest.fest_sea_festival.done: The fireworks shone on the water. Everyone cheered, and so did I.
quest.fest_lantern_night.title: Lantern Night
quest.fest_lantern_night.desc: Tonight the sky lanterns go up from the beach.
quest.fest_lantern_night.go.log: Go down to the beach and send up a lantern of my own.
quest.fest_lantern_night.done: My little light went up with all the others. I can't tell which one is mine any more.
quest.fest_maslenitsa.title: Maslenitsa
quest.fest_maslenitsa.desc: Seeing winter off: pancakes at the fair and the straw effigy on the bonfire.
quest.fest_maslenitsa.go.log: Pancakes at the fair, then down to the beach to watch the effigy burn.
quest.fest_maslenitsa.done: The effigy burnt and winter went with it. That's how it should be, they say.
quest.fest_midsummer.title: Midsummer Night
quest.fest_midsummer.desc: The shortest night: a bonfire on the beach until morning.
quest.fest_midsummer.go.log: Sit by the fire, and at dawn go and greet the sun.
quest.fest_midsummer.bonfire.obj: Stand by the bonfire on the beach
quest.fest_midsummer.sunrise.obj: Watch the sunrise from the east terrace
quest.fest_midsummer.done: The sun came up over the forest. Nobody spoke; everyone just looked at it.
quest.fest_new_year.title: New Year
quest.fest_new_year.desc: The last night of the year. Fireworks over the sea at midnight.
quest.fest_new_year.go.log: See the New Year in by the sea.
quest.fest_new_year.done: Happy New Year. Whatever that means here.
quest.fest_perseids.title: Perseid Night
quest.fest_perseids.go.log: Go down to the beach at night and watch the sky.
quest.fest_perseids.done: I made a wish. I won't say what.
festival.lunar_new_year.name: Lunar New Year
festival.lunar_new_year.today: It's Lunar New Year today: dumplings at the fair, drums on the square at five, firecrackers and fireworks at midnight.
festival.holi.name: Holi
festival.holi.today: It's Holi today, the festival of colours: from eleven everyone throws coloured powder at each other in the park.
festival.nowruz.name: Nowruz
festival.nowruz.today: It's Nowruz today, the spring New Year: a picnic in the park and a bonfire on the beach in the evening.
festival.children_day.name: Children's Day
festival.children_day.today: It's Children's Day today: balloons, games and ice cream in the park all day.
festival.tanabata.name: Tanabata
festival.tanabata.today: It's Tanabata today: bamboo on the promenade to hang paper wishes on, and stargazing at night.
festival.toro_nagashi.name: Toro nagashi
festival.toro_nagashi.today: It's Toro nagashi today: at dusk paper lanterns are set afloat on the sea from the beach.
festival.mid_autumn.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
festival.mid_autumn.today: It's the Mid-Autumn Festival today: lanterns on the square, then everyone watches the full moon from the promenade.
festival.halloween.name: Halloween
festival.halloween.today: It's Halloween today: candlelit pumpkins on the square and costumes in the evening.
festival.dia_de_muertos.name: Day of the Dead
festival.dia_de_muertos.today: The Day of the Dead: marigolds and candles in the park, remembering those who are gone.
festival.diwali.name: Diwali
festival.diwali.today: It's Diwali today, the festival of lights: lamps along the promenade, firecrackers and fireworks in the evening.
festival.loy_krathong.name: Loy Krathong
festival.loy_krathong.today: It's Loy Krathong today: under the full moon, little candle boats are set afloat on the sea.
festival.christmas.name: Christmas
festival.christmas.today: Christmas: the fair, candles and the tree on the square, and carols at five on Christmas Eve.

ui.festival.wish_tied: I tied on my wish. I won't tell anyone what it says.

quest.fest_lunar_new_year.desc: The town sees in the Lunar New Year.
quest.fest_lunar_new_year.go.log: Hear the drums on the square and stay for the firecrackers at midnight.
quest.fest_lunar_new_year.drums.obj: Hear the drums on the square
quest.fest_lunar_new_year.done: My ears are still ringing; the square smells of powder and dumplings.
quest.fest_holi.title: Holi
quest.fest_holi.desc: The festival of colours in the park.
quest.fest_holi.go.log: Go to the park where everyone is throwing colours.
quest.fest_holi.colours.obj: Stand in the clouds of colour
quest.fest_holi.done: My jacket is pink and yellow now. It won't wash out, and that's fine.
quest.fest_tanabata.title: Tanabata
quest.fest_tanabata.go.log: Write a wish and tie it on the bamboo.
quest.fest_tanabata.wish.obj: Tie a wish on the bamboo
quest.fest_tanabata.done: My strip of paper flutters in the wind with a hundred others.
quest.fest_toro_nagashi.title: Lanterns on the water
quest.fest_toro_nagashi.desc: At dusk lanterns are set afloat on the sea.
quest.fest_toro_nagashi.go.log: Set a lantern of my own afloat from the beach.
quest.fest_toro_nagashi.done: My little light has drifted far out to sea, to join the others.
quest.fest_mid_autumn.title: The moon festival
quest.fest_mid_autumn.go.log: Watch the full moon from the promenade with everyone.
quest.fest_mid_autumn.moon.obj: Watch the moon from the promenade
quest.fest_mid_autumn.done: The moon is huge, and everyone around is whispering.

item.fishing_rod.name: Fishing rod
item.fishing_rod.desc: A 2.7 m telescopic float rod with a reel. Hold it by the water: hold LMB and let go to cast; when the float goes under, LMB strikes; hold LMB to wind in, let go when the fish pulls.
item.bait_worm.name: Sea worms
item.bait_worm.desc: A tin of lugworms in damp sand. Flounder, gobies, cod and eels like them best. Hold it to bait the hook.
item.bait_maggot.name: Maggots
item.bait_maggot.desc: A box of maggots in sawdust. For the smaller fish: herring, smelt, roach and perch. Hold it to bait the hook.
item.lure_spoon.name: Spoon lure
item.lure_spoon.desc: A silver wobbling spoon with a treble hook. Casts far; hold LMB to wind it in. Predators go for it: cod, sea trout, garfish, perch. Lost only if the line breaks.

item.fish_herring.name: Baltic herring
item.fish_herring.desc: Baltic herring: slim, with a blue-green back and silver flanks. Comes inshore in schools in spring and autumn.
item.fish_sprat.name: Sprat
item.fish_sprat.desc: A sprat, a little silver fish. Takes the hook when a school passes close.
item.fish_sandeel.name: Sand eel
item.fish_sandeel.desc: A sand eel, thin as an eel. Buries itself in the sand at night and in winter.
item.fish_stickleback.name: Three-spined stickleback
item.fish_stickleback.desc: A three-spined stickleback, tiny and prickly. Nobody would buy it.
item.fish_perch.name: Perch
item.fish_perch.desc: A barred perch with red fins. Keeps to the stones and weed and greedily takes a worm or a spoon.
item.fish_cod.name: Cod
item.fish_cod.desc: A cod, mottled, with a barbel on its chin. Comes to the stony shore at night.
item.fish_seatrout.name: Sea trout
item.fish_seatrout.desc: A sea trout, silver with black spots. A strong fish: let it tire first.
item.fish_garfish.name: Garfish
item.fish_garfish.desc: A garfish with a long beak and green bones. Comes inshore in May and hits a spoon.
item.fish_roundgoby.name: Round goby
item.fish_roundgoby.desc: A round goby, big-headed and greedy. Lives on every stone of the Baltic now.
item.fish_sandgoby.name: Sand goby
item.fish_sandgoby.desc: A sand goby, tiny, the colour of the sand. Nobody buys it.
item.fish_eelpout.name: Eelpout
item.fish_eelpout.desc: An eelpout, eel-like. Gives birth to live young.
item.fish_sculpin.name: Shorthorn sculpin
item.fish_sculpin.desc: A sculpin: a huge spiny head and a wide mouth. Lies among the stones.
item.fish_lumpsucker.name: Lumpsucker
item.fish_lumpsucker.desc: A lumpsucker, round and knobbly, with a sucker on its belly. Comes to the shallow stones in spring.
item.fish_flounder.name: Flounder
item.fish_flounder.desc: A flounder. Lies on the sand and takes a worm.
item.fish_turbot.name: Turbot
item.fish_turbot.desc: A turbot, nearly round, studded with bony knobs. A prized fish that fetches a good price.
item.fish_smelt.name: European smelt
item.fish_smelt.desc: A smelt, see-through, smelling of fresh cucumber.
item.fish_twaiteshad.name: Twaite shad
item.fish_twaiteshad.desc: A twaite shad, silver with dark spots along its side. Runs to spawn in spring.
item.fish_whitefish.name: Baltic whitefish
item.fish_whitefish.desc: A whitefish, silver with a small mouth. Cautious, tastes the bait for a long time.
item.fish_salmon.name: Atlantic salmon
item.fish_salmon.desc: A Baltic salmon. A rare and very strong fish: no landing it without patience.
item.fish_roach.name: Roach
item.fish_roach.desc: A roach, silvery, with red eyes. Bites carefully: the float only trembles.
item.fish_vimba.name: Vimba bream
item.fish_vimba.desc: A vimba, with a fleshy snout. Comes into the bays in summer.
item.fish_eel.name: European eel
item.fish_eel.desc: An eel. Leaves its hole at night and twists hard on the line.
item.fish_rockgunnel.name: Rock gunnel
item.fish_rockgunnel.desc: A rock gunnel, slippery as a ribbon, spotted along the back.
item.fish_fourhornsculpin.name: Fourhorn sculpin
item.fish_fourhornsculpin.desc: A fourhorn sculpin, with bony horns on its head. Lives deeper, on cold sand.
item.fish_blackgoby.name: Black goby
item.fish_blackgoby.desc: A black goby, dark, in the weed. Takes anything.
item.fish_ninespinestickleback.name: Ninespine stickleback
item.fish_ninespinestickleback.desc: A ninespine stickleback, even smaller than the three-spined one.
item.diner_fish.name: Fried fish with potatoes
item.diner_fish.desc: Your own catch, floured and pan-fried, with boiled potatoes, dill and a wedge of lemon.
item.fish_book.name: Fishes of Our Shore
item.fish_book.desc: An angler's handbook bound in blue cloth: every fish that bites off this shore, what it takes and what the grocery pays. Your own catches go in the margins in pencil. N opens it.

item.rod_spinning.name: Spinning rod
item.rod_spinning.desc: A light 2.4 m carbon spinning rod with a braided line and a good reel: a spoon or a wobbler flies 40 metres, a big fish breaks the line less often, and it winds in faster.
item.rod_sea.name: Sea bottom rod
item.rod_sea.desc: A thick sea rod with a 100 g lead and no float: the bait lies on the bottom some forty-five metres out. You see a bite on the tip: when it knocks and bends round, strike. Cod, flounder, eelpout and eel take it; the small fish up in the water never find it.
item.bait_shrimp.name: Shrimp
item.bait_shrimp.desc: A peeled Baltic prawn for the hook. The favourite of cod, eelpout, flounder and turbot; a sea trout in the shallows won't say no either.
item.bait_dough.name: Dough
item.bait_dough.desc: A pinch of bread dough with a drop of sunflower oil. Roach and vimba take it gladly, whitefish now and then; a predator has no use for it.
item.lure_wobbler.name: Wobbler
item.lure_wobbler.desc: A floating wobbler, silver and blue: as you wind it in, it dives and wobbles like a wounded little fish. The best lure for sea trout and salmon, good for garfish and perch. It casts a little shorter than a spoon.

city.act.bed.1: I lay looking at the ceiling and dozed off without noticing.
city.act.bed.2: A short rest. My legs don't ache any more.
city.act.shelf.1: Old, worn spines. I pulled one out at random and read a couple of pages.
city.act.shelf.2: Someone left pencil notes in the margins. I wonder who read this before me.
city.act.shelf.3: It smells of paper and dust. I put the book back exactly where it was.
city.act.board.1: Notices in layers: someone is selling a bike, someone is looking for a cat.
city.act.board.2: A hand-drawn timetable. Half the numbers are corrected in pen.
city.act.board.3: I stood and read for a while. The town has a life of its own.
city.act.counter.1: "Hello! Can I help you with anything?"
city.act.counter.2: They nodded to me from behind the counter and went back to their work.
city.act.machine.1: Something clicked, hummed and went quiet.
city.act.machine.2: It works! Though I'm not quite sure how.
city.act.play.1: I played for a bit. It went better than I expected.
city.act.play.2: Another round? No, that's enough, or I'll be here till evening.
city.act.sport.1: A short workout. My arms ache pleasantly.
city.act.sport.2: Out of breath, but pleased with myself.
city.act.craft.1: I fiddled with it for half an hour. A bit crooked, but it's mine.
city.act.craft.2: My hands are dusty, but my head feels light and clear.
city.act.screen.1: I got absorbed and lost track of time.
city.act.screen.2: I watched for a while. I never got to the end.
city.act.take.1: I took one. There's a whole pile of them anyway.
